assumptions.name: fixed_anthropometry_and_club_geometry
assumptions.description: Subject segment lengths and club length/type stay fixed for a fit; geometry is not free to absorb measurement residual.

assumptions.name: joint_rate_and_acceleration_bounds
assumptions.source: reviewed golf ROM literature envelope (named assumption)
assumptions.description: Joint rates and accelerations are softly bounded; values are regularizers, not measured kinematics.

assumptions.name: bilateral_grip_closure
assumptions.description: Hands remain welded to the grip within closure tolerance.

assumptions.name: stance_contact_and_nonpenetration
assumptions.description: Foot/ground contact and non-penetration apply when the model exposes contact; absent contact state fails closed.

assumptions.name: posture_and_effort_regularization
assumptions.description: Unobserved null-space motion is pulled toward a golf posture prior and low effort; score cannot override measured residual.

limitations: Face orientation is unsupported without a calibrated face frame; orientation limitation is declared rather than a distorted target.
Lower-extremity body markers are out of scope for this model class.
Reduced-model club-only profiles do not satisfy full-body G3.
